answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the pigment of a task receipt, and the shale is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the relic of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, expired if not renewed by fresh work, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
